description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCacheFactory, responsible for creating and managing definition cache objects within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for setup, registration, creation, and decoration of cache objects, facilitating cache management and decorator pattern application.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCacheFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing definition cache objects, including setup, registration, and decorator application.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes default decorators for the cache factory, specifically adding a 'Cleanup' decorator.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the cache factory, optionally replacing it with a provided prototype.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new cache implementation class with a short name for future reference.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a cache object based on configuration or returns a null cache if unspecified.

methods.name: addDecorator
methods.description: Adds a decorator to all cache objects created by this factory, accepting either a class name or an instance.
